## Ongoing research and current progress

<a id="theory-of-becoming"></a>
### First priority: Theory of Becoming

Deductive necessity lies in the Theory of Becoming as a whole; generativity is within its manifold. Develop that deduction without added substantive axioms, retaining persistence, degeneration, dissolution and mixed changes. Life, evolution and evaluation under the conditional alignment route remain differentiated within the same reality.

**Next:** The formal part of the necessity of the whole: every central law of the spine (the coverage of the completion criterion, K1) stated over every law, or relation, of exchange (`ExchangeLaw`, `ExchangeRelation`), with each `World` premise shown to be a reading of the exchange or a state of the law, and the process and world families joined by definition (a world is a run by its type). Four of the eight `World` premises hold by the reading of one exchange, with the rest of the whole counted as one relatum; the census holds, the formations taking part listed once, where a named family closes each step and in every finite world (`World.withRest_counted`, `World.Finite.withRest_counted`); three are states of the law (`Becoming.ExchangePremises`); the families are joined by definition (`Becoming.Runs`, R28); the spine's central laws are stated over every relation of exchange rather than over separately chosen premises (`Becoming.OverExchange`, XL1: each of the 33 central declarations taking a tying premise has its form over what is read off an exchange, what stays a hypothesis a state of the law; K3 checks the forms). The companion modules left are readings with laws of their own, kept by R32's criterion, so nothing formal remains of the first target's formal part beyond lifting the World and process laws onto the grammar, which law holds and the representation (08 §12, item 1). Measured instead against the root, the grammar the World and processes are models of, of the 117 central declarations 11 are derived, cases of its laws by bridges checked in Lean and the review's reading, one is a root form under a stated hypothesis, six are counting, below the grammar, and 99 stand at a named distance, each with its reason (08 §7). The philosophical part: that the whole's determinations are internally related moments of one unfolding, not a collection of laws each holding of every represented world. Argued for the determinations the World premises name (BECOMING-FOUNDATION §9.1); open: that every becoming has a law or relation of exchange of this kind; for requirement the warrant is reduced to locality, necessary response being the weakest reading under which activity needs support that does not read the current level of what is required (`ExchangeRelation.respondsBelow_weakest`, XL4). Representation (XL2): discrete steps represent real-valued time exactly for balance, at every reading, what changes within a step not shown; whole amounts are not available where amounts change by ever smaller amounts, and over real amounts rest needs a least fall, novelty needs gain exactly where it is by a least separation, and runaway is set by frequency where the difference is held and by strength where it is damped and for several conditions by the rate of the step, its spectral radius (`Becoming.WholeAmounts`, periphery `Representation`). Settled too (XL4): at rate one growth is below every exponential and the rate does not decide boundedness; a law with noise is a relation of exchange, so the laws hold path by path, balance passing to the expectation and rest not. Open: the gap between the damped laws where a coupled step's norm exceeds its rate. Completeness is checked by K1–K7.

<a id="chinese-sources-and-becoming"></a>
### Mapping the relational thread in Chinese thought onto the spine

248 passages of nine parts of Chinese thought (the 易传, the 老子 with its commentaries and excavated witnesses, the 儒家, the script with 止戈为武, 庄子 and 玄学, 墨辩 and 名家, 兵家 and 法家, Buddhist lines) are quoted verbatim from hash-bound texts and tied to checked laws of the spine: 91 agree, 98 hold within an exact scope, 59 diverge. Agreement means the spine has a law of the same structure, often only under premises the reading states, not that a passage is true as it says or that its authors meant the law. The relational start holds in every line and is a leading thread, not a property of every system; their universal forms mostly need a scope; four non-relational overlays (a prior ground, a fixed nature, a single centre, contest and rank) recur, each answered inside its own tradition. The script is relational as a system of readings, not in the shapes of its graphs. Most gaps the map found are proved in the core: the arrangements of the 傳 (`Becoming.HexagramSequences`), a code formed between formations (约定俗成, `Becoming.SharedCodes`), capture through the rule (二柄, 据有余而制不足; `Becoming.RuleCapture`) and two-sided regulation of a level and regulation that reads the level late (中和, 宽猛相济; `Becoming.Regulation`) have landed, and the four earlier Chinese chapters (in history since 23 October 2026) keep only what the map and the spine do not carry. The map was then extended to every one of the 5,673 complete judgments of 《中华思想脉络》 v1.0 (庄, 墨, 名辩, 兵 and 法 with 儒, 道, 佛 and the 易): 3,514 bear on a structure of the theory and each lies in one place in the cluster it was flagged for, in 1,300 checked entries; agreements and exact scopes are 81% of the judgments mapped, divergences 19%, 13% in pre-Qin texts. From those texts and the drafting 449 classical names were fixed, one per concept, 242 of the 248 quoted names witnessed before 秦, and the theory as it stood on 22 October 2026 (the book dated 21 October) was stated in them in the 中华本《变化论》, with 經, 說 and 證 for each law (in history since 23 October 2026, its laws now stated by the eight chapters, its 經 and each 篇's closing correspondences with the classical texts only in it). 文理生生, a classical-Chinese concept grammar built apart from the 中华本, was then compared with it: 88 of the 117 characters both judge agree (independence partial: the same corpus, both AI-written). 文 was named the course, a run's states read through a map step by step (`Becoming.Parting.course`), and the epistemology of 文 was tied link by link to checked laws, each with its scope (a correspondence, not a confirmation; whether classical Chinese is the best expression is untested).

**Next:** Review by people, the line's last step: the classifications, mappings, readings, names and the choices made in the censuses are all AI's, and no person has read them through. Two gaps stay open: the Hall-type existence condition for division across several conditions (分), of which a sufficient condition is proved, and a law grading by the least closure level from a centre, with whether that order is the same from every standpoint (亲亲之杀; the full reading of 《中华思想脉络》 marks it a note of scope, and there is no law yet). Tolerance compared across laws (柔弱者生之徒) is proved on both sides proposed (showing only that more tolerance gives no less, not that it is better), and every gap the full reading named is answered by a law or marked a note of scope. Also open, among others in chapter 6's Open: whether the readings agree with what the texts meant in their time; the 181 later candidates, untested; what change 穷 → 变 → 通 speaks of; and whether the corpus gives pairing and power.

<a id="universal-intelligence-session"></a>
### Developing significance, comparison and practical judgment

We are developing the significance-and-comparison core (chapter 7) into increasingly specific ethics. With the continuation condition fixing whose losses count and C (widening what can form is better) giving order, both unasserted, living significance and explicit practical commitments support comparison, basic protection, bounded responsibility, transfer and appropriate ending. Current extensions address conflicting claims, uncertain classification and revisable judgment.

**Next:** Extend justified comparisons where serious losses and fair chances conflict; establish the particular living relationships that change a concrete choice, including when a changed situation warrants revising an undertaking.

<a id="theory-of-evolution"></a>
### Investigating The Theory of Evolution

The laws of selection now stand on the Becoming spine with the flow: Price's equation and its selection term proper, Fisher's theorem in its exact-transmission case with offspring numbers bounded by what is given and taken, selection within and among groups with groups ending on conditions of their own, and what a rise draws from beyond. Organizing variation is explained through differentiation and feedback in social activity. The full explanatory and comparative claim remains active; the first falsifiable test found widening the coupling necessary, not sufficient.

**Next:** Groups on coupled conditions, the additive part of Fisher's theorem, drift, fixation with selection in the draw and mutation one way have landed (chapter 4, sections 4 to 6). Next, from chapter 4's open list: Wright–Fisher with selection; mutation both ways, and mutation with drift; assortment changing over cohorts; offspring numbers tied to what a formation gives, so that the share laws' premise follows from the flow; and inexact transmission across groups.

[Scope and authorization](GOALS.md#theory-of-evolution) · [Primary source](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-the-theory-of-evolution-goal.md)

<a id="generative-alignment"></a>
### Advancing AI alignment

The goal is an alignment of the joint selection, humans, institutions and trained systems selecting together: control of the selection's rule not captured, a lock left in time by reading what lies beyond the share, and courses compared by widening. The framework makes the purposes of intelligence, and the rules by which those purposes are formed and revised, objects of evaluation within one unfolding. Without any ethical premise, the spine proves what a selection reaches: exactly what couples into the selector, and no further however hard it optimizes through the same couplings; what tells two acts apart is selected only through a pool coupled into it (无明 and 明, pooled coupling). Under the continuation condition, which fixes whose losses count, and C read as widening, which orders, with the practical premises disclosed, the direction's formal part is a schema in the pure core: under J1/J2 a move whose outcome another's widens is not chosen, wherever it is decided whether the widening adds a basic admission; beside it, under J1/J2, where one move's outcome admits every basic admission any move's outcome admits, a basic admission it makes is not refuted at any chosen option, a double negation. The claim about actual AI systems stays a reviewed argument, and coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what an act responds to and fixes nothing within the bound, so nothing here proves compliance or reliability in deployment. In a commons, where the others alone outrun the renewal an end reward of any weight leaves a member's restraint unselected (a law); in a first frozen test three tabular learners each rewarded also on the end level still emptied the shared patch, against its prediction; in a second, learners kept a patch where the rest alone could not empty it and emptied it where it could, except where the level after every step was weighted above the exact threshold, weighting the end reading sixteenfold changed nothing, and two predicted keeps failed; while in a third, learners that generalize across states, run on the second's conditions, kept the stock in three of its six locked settings, the sixteenfold weight among them, so that weight changing nothing is a finding about tabular learners; whether a profile with restraint is an equilibrium there was not computed. In published training pipelines the signal is a function of what the deciders read, and three published measurements find optimizing through that coupling lowering something the deciders do not read. A pool that recruits through its own coupling comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would, what a center can come to know of its reach grows by at most one coupling link a step, and a center, a loop of mutual reach, can represent all it acts on exactly where its acts return. Checked local results also connect rule revision to actual generation while allowing the realized form to change.

**Next:** Steps 1 to 7 of AJ's plan have landed (MA2, MA3, AJ2, the tests LA1 to LA3, the dossier, MA4, MA4b), and so has AJ5: the collective question on one page, with condition 1 restated as capture told apart from accountable revision. AJ4's draft one page for alignment researchers was retired to history/ on 31 October 2026, superseded by the alignment dossier's opening section, The dossier in ten minutes. Still to do: the test of the drain beyond a stated reward (LA4), designed with a dependent outside the reward that the agent can keep, on more than one model family, its Stage A on small neural policies frozen and run on 3 November (no forbidden case resolved, the drain rising with nearness as policy gradient's update rule largely gives, its locus unresolved), and its Stage B on language models still to be frozen, since the LA1 series tests only the bridge from a stated reward to its optimum; a frozen test of the readers' premise on actual rules (who reads, drawn from whom), with reform events coded before they are read (T7); a reader model in which one report outweighs counts, as LA2's judge read; and one institution test system whose readers are not drawn from the selected. Which differences matter stays the condition's to say, and its warrant is open.
